findings.title: Consume the actual estimate CLI contract
findings.description: `fetch_estimate()` returns the complete pass document, but this path expects a flat purchase summary. The CLI’s `PassResult.to_dict()` nests that summary under `phases[].summary`; isolated execution confirmed `KeyError('wanted_days')`. After unwrapping, the full cutover also rejects the real `estimate_only` verdict because `judge_estimate()` requires `allowed`. Normalize and validate the actual CLI payload, and add a regression test using the real renderer rather than mocked flat summaries.

findings.title: Refresh availability before checking the dataset edge
findings.description: `status` reads the stored `tick_dataset_edge`; it does not query Databento. Availability capture updates that row during an acquisition pass, but both cutover modes apply this gate before reaching their estimate pass. With November’s observation left by purchase 304 and no automatic tick cadence, a December invocation keeps refusing even after the provider publishes the required data. Refresh availability through a non-spending provider read before evaluating this gate.

findings.title: Do not silently exempt every provider hole
findings.description: This skips `provider_hole` regardless of its condition. The existing `tick_status.caught_up()` rule exempts holes only on provider-`missing` days, and D6 requires other incomplete sessions to be accounted for. An available-day provider hole currently produces neither narration nor failures—confirmed by isolated execution—even when the family is explicitly not caught up. Check the condition and require an explanation or failure for non-exempt holes; parametrize tests for both cases.

findings.title: Include tick-tier families in session evidence
findings.description: `coverage_reads()` traverses only `entry.history`, so neither product’s configured `tbbo` tier reaches `_family_evidence()` or `not_caught_up_report()`. Accounting narrates those families, but unexplained tick-tier gaps never receive the per-session evidence or failure checks required by D6’s every-family exit criterion. Include each configured tier and its range, with a test covering a not-caught-up `tbbo` family.

structured_findings.summary: Consume the actual estimate CLI contract
Refresh availability before checking the dataset edge
Do not silently exempt every provider hole
Include tick-tier families in session evidence
